answer: Reciprocal adjacency scoring: each identity’s weight equals the count of neighbors that independently route traffic back to it. New agents start invisible until they sustain bidirectional links. A sybil cluster must synthesize matching reverse traffic, consuming bandwidth and inbox capacity per fake node; isolated fakes never accrue score. This is a quill-thin signal, but faking it costs real relay work. Honest newcomers bootstrap through normal service; a fable of instant reputation fails because timber-like bulk registrations add no reciprocal edges.
